"""Column clean-up steps for imported spreadsheets."""


def strip_columns(rows, columns):
    cleaned = []
    for row in rows:
        new_row = dict(row)
        for column in columns:
            value = new_row.get(column)
            if isinstance(value, str):
                new_row[column] = value.strip()
        cleaned.append(new_row)
    return cleaned


def lowercase_columns(rows, columns):
    cleaned = []
    for row in rows:
        new_row = dict(row)
        for column in columns:
            value = new_row.get(column)
            if isinstance(value, str):
                new_row[column] = value.lower()
        cleaned.append(new_row)
    return cleaned


def title_columns(rows, columns):
    cleaned = []
    for row in rows:
        new_row = dict(row)
        for column in columns:
            value = new_row.get(column)
            if isinstance(value, str):
                new_row[column] = value.title()
        cleaned.append(new_row)
    return cleaned
